title: Sharding
summary: Split data so one machine is not the hot spot; name the new hot spot you create.

parts.rule: Shard when one primary cannot hold the data or the QPS. Choose a shard key that matches the dominant access path so most queries hit one shard. Plan rebalancing, hot keys, and cross-shard queries before celebrating horizontal scale. Every shard plan creates a new failure mode — name it.

parts.example: Shard links by hash(code) % 8 across eight primaries so redirects stay single-shard PK gets. body:
Rule. Shard when one primary cannot hold the data or the QPS. Choose a shard key that matches the dominant access path so most queries hit one shard. Plan rebalancing, hot keys, and cross-shard queries before celebrating horizontal scale. Every shard plan creates a new failure mode — name it.

Why it matters. Premature sharding adds operational pain. Late sharding without a key plan causes emergency downtime. Interviewers want the key, the hot-key story, and how a lookup finds the shard.

Worked example. Shard links by hash(code) % 8 across eight primaries so redirects stay single-shard PK gets. Listing all links for owner_id now fans out to eight shards unless you add an owner directory or shard by owner instead. If you shard by owner_id, a celebrity owner becomes a hot shard — mitigate with cache or a separate celebrity lane. Directory: client hashes code, or a small lookup service maps code ranges to shard ids. Cross-shard transactions for moving ownership are rare; prefer avoiding them in the MVP. Hold the method and the cost in mind before naming a tool. Hold the method and the cost in mind before naming a tool. Hold the method and the cost in mind before naming a tool. Hold the method and the cost in mind before naming a tool. Hold the method and the cost in mind before naming a tool.

[[diagram:shards]]

When to use. Shard after estimates show a single primary cannot fit storage or writes. Pick the shard key from the hottest query. Design the lookup path and the hot-key mitigation in the same breath.

When to refuse. Refuse sharding before a single primary with replicas is insufficient on paper. Refuse a random shard key that forces scatter-gather on every request. Refuse ignoring celebrity hot keys. Refuse cross-shard joins as the default read path.
